protocol.cache_scope: Exactly core.projections.projection_paths at each untouched checkpoint, saved before corruption; no primary fact removal.
protocol.comparison: Full pure views and full worker observations within each checkpoint; no value or identity normalization.
protocol.world_construction: Real adapter calls only; copying and declared cache replacement are the sole harness interventions.

interpretation: Finite cache-invariance witnesses at actual two-template checkpoints, not independent samples, event-log reconstruction, arbitrary-state recovery or model performance.

omitted: Repeated per-variant pure view and observation bodies
Repeated per-variant file inventories already retained at the corresponding checkpoint
Inline checkpoint action arrays, recoverable from cited raw states and the unmodified raw report
archive_metadata.preserved: Protocol, every check, errors, identities, all checkpoint/before/after references and hashes, cache paths and base-fact hashes. This is a compact evidence index, not a replacement for raw worlds.
